text: My daily routine starts early. I usually wake up at seven o'clock and have a quick shower. After a healthy breakfast, I check my emails and get ready for work. I start work at nine and follow a regular schedule with a short lunch break at noon. In the afternoon, I often go for a run or visit the gym to stay fit. In the evening, I cook dinner, watch a little TV, and read a book before bed. I try to keep the same routine every day because consistency helps me feel calm, organised, and full of energy.
